TICKETS
Academy Music Group presents BREED 77 plus supports TBC live Downstairs at The Dome
Breed 77 formed in London in 1996. Originally comprised of members from Gibraltar, a small British Territory at the mouth of the Mediterranean – this birthed their sound; a unique fusion of Flamenco and North African influences mixed with alternative Rock & Metal, equal parts exotic and explosive!
Cutting their teeth on the UK live circuit, it wasn’t long before the band was named Best Unsigned Act by Kerrang and Best New Band by Metal Hammer on the back of relentless touring. In 1999, a mere 3 years after forming, the band is selected as the sole support for the Black Sabbath Original Line-up reunion at the London Astoria – the show goes down a storm and at the start of the new millennium Breed 77 sign to Alberts UK .
They release 4 albums on Alberts; Breed 77 2001, Cultura 2004, In My Blood (En Mi Sangre) 2006 and the Spanish language Un Encuentro in 2007. It was with Cultura that things really took off – entering the UK rock charts at number 3 and spawning 3 singles that bothered the mainstream charts with ballad The River breaking into the UK Top 40 at a time when rock was not common in the charts.
In 2009, Insects is released on La Rocka Records, a sprawling concept album ripe with social and political commentary – featuring the stand-out cover of The Cranberries, Zombie.
The Evil Inside is released on Frostbyte/Universal in 2013, darker, moodier and a straight-up rockier affair; lead single Bring On The Rain launches to critical acclaim.
Breed 77 is known for their incendiary live shows and have toured the world extensively with the likes of Megadeth, Machine Head, Korn, Life of Agony & Prong and many more.
Fast forward to the present day and Breed 77 is back – new album VII set to release in November 2026 – 3 singles out already: End Of The Line, Outside & Just Act Like You Know – with triumphant performances at Bloodstock Open Air UK, Uprising UK & Z-Live ESP, the future’s on fire right now for Breed 77!

gig.description: Wilco - A Tour With Wilco is coming to Eventim Apollo this August. For 30 years, Wilco has been a pioneering force in independent music. The Chicago rock band has released 13 studio albums and won multiple Grammy Awards. They have founded their own record label, dBpm Records, and renowned Solid Sound festival. The sextet comprised of Jeff Tweedy, John Stirratt, Glenn Kotche, Pat Sansone, Nels Cline, and Mikael Jorgensen—continues to be regarded as a live powerhouse, as described by NPR, “To see Wilco on stage is to hear the best of the best.” The band’s newest album, Cousin, was released in 2023, followed by 2024’s Hot Sun Cool Shroud EP.

why: independent and alt-country rock

gig.title: Jordan Rakei
gig.description: Jordan Rakei brings his biggest-ever headline show to Alexandra Palace as part of the A Safe Place To Be Wild Tour in April 2027. Following the announcement of his new album A Safe Place To Be Wild, the Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, producer and multi-instrumentalist returns to London for the biggest headline show of his career. Expect music from the forthcoming record, including latest single Enemies, alongside fan favourites from across his celebrated catalogue, which blends soul, jazz and R&B into a distinctive sound. Across six acclaimed albums, collaborations with Bonobo, Tom Misch and Loyle Carner, and sold-out shows at the Royal Albert Hall, he has established himself as one of the UK’s most compelling live performers. Age restriction 16+

why: soul, jazz and R&B
